obesity.why: Higher technical difficulty and longer operative/anesthesia time.

anticoagulant_or_antiplatelet.why: Perioperative anticoagulation/antiplatelet use often adds hemostasis and management time.

malignancy_or_carcinoma.why: Oncologic cases are often more extensive and prolonged.

coronary_artery_disease.why: Cardiac comorbidity can increase perioperative complexity and delay.

renal_failure_or_ckd.pattern: \b(?:renal failure|kidney failure|CKD|chronic kidney disease|ESRD|end[- ]stage renal|dialysis|renal insufficiency)\b
renal_failure_or_ckd.why: Renal disease is associated with more complex perioperative management.

general_anesthesia.why: General anesthesia often corresponds to longer cases than regional/local techniques.

estimated_blood_loss_ml.why: Greater blood loss usually reflects more complex or prolonged surgery.

multiple_procedures_or_additional_work.why: Extra operative steps or combined procedures increase duration.
